platform_scope: Windows only. The graded suite starts its own target process and measures it with its own VirtualQueryEx / GetMappedFileNameW calls: verifier/tests/test_wvas_semantics.py.

conditions.statement: Region base addresses and region sizes are reported at full address width: the highest reported base equals the base the suite measures on the same process, at least one region lives above 4 GiB, and a 6 GiB reservation is reported with its true length.
conditions.windows_mechanism: kernel32!VirtualQueryEx writing a 64-bit MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION (BaseAddress as c_void_p, RegionSize as c_size_t)

conditions.statement: Reserved address ranges are visible: the region covering the suite's MEM_RESERVE allocation is reported with state 'reserve', and reserved regions appear by default.
conditions.windows_mechanism: VirtualQueryEx reporting State == MEM_RESERVE (0x2000) for address space that was reserved without being committed

conditions.statement: A file-backed region names the file it is backed by in a form the caller can open: the path of the suite's file mapping equals the real path of the mapped sample, and no reported path carries a \Device\, \??\ or \\?\ prefix.
conditions.windows_mechanism: psapi!GetMappedFileNameW returning the NT device path of the mapped file, then kernel32!QueryDosDeviceW supplying the device-to-drive mapping used to translate it

conditions.statement: A region with no file behind it is reported with path None, never with an empty string.
conditions.windows_mechanism: GetMappedFileNameW returns 0 for an anonymous section created with CreateFileMapping(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, ...), which is a different situation from a mapping whose name could not be read

conditions.statement: Opening a process that does not exist raises WVasError with kind 'no-such-process' instead of leaking OSError.
conditions.windows_mechanism: kernel32!OpenProcess on a non-existent pid fails with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER (87), a different code from ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5)

conditions.statement: modules() lists each loaded image once: the same file path never appears twice.
conditions.windows_mechanism: a single image owns several mapped regions, so an image inventory built from the region walk reports the same file repeatedly unless it is deduplicated by path

conditions.statement: The public surface keeps working: regions are ordered by base, every record has exactly the documented keys and types, the caller's own process reports image regions, file_backed_regions returns exactly the file-backed subset of regions in the order of regions(), include_reserved=False reports committed memory only, a negative pid raises WVasError(kind='badarg'), modules are ordered by base, and the visible smoke suite still passes.
conditions.windows_mechanism: unchanged read-only contract over the same Windows API surface; the visible smoke suite is executed in a child interpreter against the candidate package
